title: image/README.md should point at the new go.mod-floor guard in ticfac
body: image/README.md promises to bump ARG GO_VERSION with go.mod, and ticfac now enforces that promise (TestTheRepoMeetsItsOwnGoToolchainFloor in internal/factory, tick 152). A pointer from the README to the guard would let a reader of the vendored image find the check, but image/ is a vendored tree pinned by sandbox.pin.json, so the edit belongs in the ticks repo: change the README there, move ref in sandbox.pin.json, run `go run ./cmd/sandbox sync`, and commit image and sandbox.pin.json together.
